rules: Keep prescribed, recorded, athlete-reported, derived, interpreted, and proposed values distinct.
Do not compare whole-activity average heart rates as matched work-block economy.
No exact drift or physiology was reconstructed from screenshots.
Garmin effort is activity-level. Do not equate its 3/10 directly with another system's RPE 7 without checking reporting context.
A race goal, watch zone, execution score, or stamina estimate is not proof of threshold, reserve, or VO2max.
Historical volume does not confirm recent readiness; a new comparison needs context and recovery.
